svg.title: Paid work. Two systems clients paid for, Pawtrait and Snapose.
svg.desc: How an engagement runs: reach, scope, flow, close, build, hand over. Pawtrait, a DIY pet photobox: kiosk, operator console, camera and printer control, template editor, finance, soft-file gallery. Snapose, photobooth studio software that runs a night offline and syncs to the studio's Drive, five apps down to one per event. Both built under Crescens Labs.

g.text: Two systems clients paid for. I closed both deals and wrote code for both.

svg.text: KIOSK. THE CUSTOMER RUNS THE SESSION ALONE.
